_meta.note: A dependency-free stdio MCP server (one tool, crew_probe_echo -> a fixed marker) passed in the session/new mcpServers array, driven to a ROUND TRIP. session/new accepted the element; the model called the tool and the result carries the marker `crew-stdio-mount-proved`, so the transport is mounted and the tool is REACHABLE, not merely accepted. The tool grammar on this host is mcp__<server>__<tool> (mcp__ prefix, DOUBLE underscores), and the server name `crew-probe` is normalized to `crew_probe` in the tool id. NO session/request_permission fired for this MCP call: the adapter auto-approved it under the seeded promptUnmatched policy (it drew a real permission for the builtin shell command in turn-live.jsonl). Covers tool_call and tool_call_update(completed) for the MCP tool, agent_message_chunk, and the session/prompt result with stopReason. Reductions: session id -> muse-session-1, uuids/tool-call ids -> fixed synthetic values; home/scratch paths -> ~. The ids are synthetic; nothing else is altered.
